description: This file defines the EntityEcaAction class, which encapsulates an action triggered by entity change events in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages service invocation, including synchronous/asynchronous execution, error handling, and user context.

classes.name: EntityEcaAction
classes.description: Represents an entity change event action, capable of executing specified services with configurable parameters such as mode, user context, and error handling.

methods.name: EntityEcaAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the action based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to invoke.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service action, handling sync/async modes, user context, and errors.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the action's configuration.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the action's properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityEcaAction object based on properties.
